---
title: "MEG amplitude time courses"
output: html_document
---

## Read data

Load the functions and read the four condition summaries from `data/02_meg_results`. These contain regional means and between-participant standard errors.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
if(.Platform$OS.type=="windows") invisible(Sys.setlocale("LC_CTYPE","English_United States.utf8"))
root <- Sys.getenv("DUAL_AGENCY_ROOT", unset=getwd())
while(!file.exists(file.path(root,"dual-agency-pathways.Rproj"))) {
  parent <- dirname(root)
  if(identical(parent,root)) stop("Open the project or set DUAL_AGENCY_ROOT.")
  root <- parent
}
source(file.path(root,"analysis/common.R"),encoding="UTF-8",local=TRUE)
```

```{r}
source(file.path(project_root,"analysis/02_meg_results/meg_timecourse_plot_utils.R"),local=TRUE,encoding="UTF-8")

dir_data <- file.path(data_root,"02_meg_results")
dir_out <- out_dir("02_meg_results",TRUE)

ensure_dir(dir_out)
```

```{r read-data}
dat_action <- bind_rows(
  read_tc_summary(
    path = file.path(dir_data, "ta_action_va_12.csv"),
    condition_label = "Voluntary",
    roi_order = roi12
  ),
  read_tc_summary(
    path = file.path(dir_data, "ta_action_ia_12.csv"),
    condition_label = "Involuntary",
    roi_order = roi12
  )
)

dat_outcome <- bind_rows(
  read_tc_summary(
    path = file.path(dir_data, "ta_outcome_vs_12.csv"),
    condition_label = "Voluntary",
    roi_order = roi12
  ),
  read_tc_summary(
    path = file.path(dir_data, "ta_outcome_is_12.csv"),
    condition_label = "Involuntary",
    roi_order = roi12
  )
)
```

## Plot time courses

Set the colours, fonts and panel dimensions, then draw the action- and outcome-binding panels.

```{r plot-settings}
font_size <- 6
line_width <- .35
plot_width_cm <- 16.29
plot_height_cm <- 10.5
dpi <- 300
action_highlight_rois <- c("DLPFCR","PreSMAL","PreSMAR","SMAR","InsulaR","AGR")
outcome_highlight_rois <- c("PrecentralR","PostcentralL","PostcentralR","SPGL","PrecuneusR","MTGR")
highlight_border_color <- "#A236B9"
highlight_border_width <- .90
normal_border_width <- .20
pal_action_line <- c(Voluntary="#1E90FF",Involuntary="#FF7518")
pal_action_fill <- c(Voluntary="#9FD0F2",Involuntary="#FFC980")
pal_outcome_line <- c(Voluntary="#0BDA51",Involuntary="#FF69B4")
pal_outcome_fill <- c(Voluntary="#B4E39A",Involuntary="#F9D1DC")
ribbon_alpha_action <- c(Voluntary=.75,Involuntary=.80)
ribbon_alpha_outcome <- c(Voluntary=.75,Involuntary=.80)
```

```{r plot-action, fig.width=plot_width_cm/2.54, fig.height=plot_height_cm/2.54, dpi=dpi, out.width="100%"}

p_action <- plot_mean_SE_tc(
  dat = dat_action,
  pal_line = pal_action_line,
  pal_fill = pal_action_fill,
  title_text = "Action binding",
  ncol = 4,
  ribbon_order = c("Involuntary", "Voluntary"),
  ribbon_alpha = ribbon_alpha_action,
  border_lw=normal_border_width, base_size=font_size, line_width=line_width,
  highlight_regions=action_highlight_rois,
  highlight_border_color=highlight_border_color, highlight_border_lw=highlight_border_width
)

p_action
```

```{r plot-outcome, fig.width=plot_width_cm/2.54, fig.height=plot_height_cm/2.54, dpi=dpi, out.width="100%"}

p_outcome <- plot_mean_SE_tc(
  dat = dat_outcome,
  pal_line = pal_outcome_line,
  pal_fill = pal_outcome_fill,
  title_text = "Outcome binding",
  ncol = 4,
  ribbon_order = c("Involuntary", "Voluntary"),
  ribbon_alpha = ribbon_alpha_outcome,
  border_lw=normal_border_width, base_size=font_size, line_width=line_width,
  highlight_regions=outcome_highlight_rois,
  highlight_border_color=highlight_border_color, highlight_border_lw=highlight_border_width
)

p_outcome
```

## Save the figure

Save the combined PDF to `figures/02_meg_results/meg_timecourses.pdf`.

```{r save-figures}
combined <- patchwork::wrap_plots(p_action,p_outcome,ncol=1)
for(ext in "pdf") ggsave(file.path(dir_out,paste0("meg_timecourses.",ext)),combined,
  width=plot_width_cm,height=2*plot_height_cm,units="cm",device=if(ext=="pdf")cairo_pdf else"png",dpi=300,bg="white")
```
